submittedParameters.prompt:
Edit reference 1 into ONE complete transparent run-W frame 10 for the mountain guardian boy. Correct ONLY upper-body camera consistency, shoulder/elbow/wrist anatomy, hands and weapon attachment. Reference 2 (W03) is the STRICT torso/shoulder-camera and anatomical-side anchor: running LEFT, the boy's anatomical LEFT shoulder and LEFT shield-bearing forearm are the NEAR side visible to us; anatomical RIGHT shoulder/arm and the staff are the FAR side. Keep that SAME visible side of the body. Do not rotate the chest into a front view, do not switch chest and back, and never swap which arm is nearest.
Near left shield advances a little farther toward image-left from the previous phase, still clearly close to camera. Far right staff hand returns toward a neutral far-side bent-elbow position, keeping the staff upright or slightly inclined. This is an independent intermediate arm pose, not W03 duplicated.
The near LEFT arm's jade-and-gold shield must remain at image-left or central torso in the foreground. Its elbow, forearm and wrist form one continuous connected limb; the left fist grips its hidden handle naturally and may be correctly occluded by shield. The far RIGHT hand holds the staff continuously with fingers closed around the shaft, thumb opposed, wrist aligned with forearm. No bent-back wrists, spare hands, disconnected arms or hovering weapons. Keep independent subtle shoulder/elbow/hand changes for this frame, with restrained running arm amplitude.
CRITICAL LOWER-BODY LOCK: preserve reference 1's entire leg pose, knee placement, calf, corrected boot axes, toe direction, supporting foot identity, planted sole contact, foot heights and footprint locations. This is an upper-body repair; DO NOT use reference 2's legs, stance or phase. The anatomical RIGHT leg remains the support foot throughout this target half-cycle. Preserve head scale, face identity, character root, flowing robe/ribbons, camera distance and square canvas. Only shoulder-facing cloth needed for the upper-body repair may change.
Reference 3 is identity/material design. Reference 4 locks the existing polished rounded detailed Q-style rendering. Reproduce the same gold armor, jade trim, brown hair and ornate staff/shield. One full-body sprite, real transparent background, no text, grid, shadow or environment. No mirroring, global translation, collaging, pose interpolation or duplicate sprite.
